findings.summary: Deployment kit proxies container loopback and binds gateway to host loopback, contradicting the approved Docker Caddy-to-host 172.20.0.1:8790 topology; all public API access fails.
Required local E2E command exits 1: forced failure never reaches fake Telegram. Harness does not isolate/seed the separate authoritative retry-context read used by production events.
First-install runbook restarts the gateway before installing its unit and starts a tunnel without instructions to start/configure the laptop remote API listener.
Gateway request logger mistakes the full HTTP request line for status and logs OAuth code/state query values.
GET logout mutates sessions without Origin/header checks; POST guard accepts arbitrary nonempty X-Flow-Request values instead of requiring 1.
Telegram task retry pins run state, while the real laptop compares task state, causing valid failed-task retries to be rejected as stale.
Advertised note command is accepted by the web/gateway but has no laptop dispatcher and returns COMMAND_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Phone brief editor omits the required task, offers no criteria edit, hides editing on launched plans, and uses plan-state preconditions against an active run-state reader.
Run-level reopen form sends no task although the laptop reopen dispatcher requires params.task, so Reabrir ejecucion fails.
Ordinary plans waiting for approval emit no plan.waiting event unless they also have a scheduler decision request.
Gateway restart loses offline snapshots/read caches and resets SSE sequence IDs, suppressing new events behind an old Last-Event-ID without resynchronization.
Gateway SSE history, notification outbox/history and abandoned expired sessions grow without bounded retention or the promised 90-day history pruning.
Failed probes overwrite snapshot cachedAt, there is no stable offlineSince, and the web omits the required outage-start time.
Laptop remote failure-review redaction recognizes only four credential names; synthetic provider API key assignments and bearer authorization text reach the control plane unchanged.
T9 socket-preserving reload is absent: stale server is terminated/restarted and serve creates a new listening socket.
Web discards unknown-outcome command envelopes and generates a new idempotency key on each retry, with no same-key reconciliation/retry path.
Published command schema describes the gateway envelope as the laptop body, disagrees on key length, and omits answer-decision and the required round selector.
